tagPath.description: The tag path to display. The component will automatically extract the tag name and read the value.

showTagName.description: Whether to display the tag name label.

showTagValue.description: Whether to display the tag value.

tagNameLabel.description: Custom label for the tag name. If empty, the tag name will be extracted from the tag path.

valuePrecision.description: Number of decimal places to display for numeric values.

row.description: When true, displays tag name and value side-by-side (horizontal). When false, displays top-to-bottom (vertical).

evenRow.description: When true and row is true, evenly distributes tag name and value across the component (each takes 50% width). Only applies when row is true.

verticalAlign.description: Vertical alignment of both labels within the component. 'top' aligns to the top, 'center' centers vertically, 'bottom' aligns to the bottom.

showUnits.description: When true, reads and displays the engineering units (EngUnit) for the tag value. The unit will be appended to the value (e.g., '52.4 psi').

boolean.description: Boolean value text configuration. When the tag value is a boolean, display custom text instead of 'true' or 'false'.

textOnTrue.description: Text to display when the boolean value is true. If empty, displays 'true'.

textOnFalse.description: Text to display when the boolean value is false. If empty, displays 'false'.

bounds.description: Bounds configuration for value highlighting. When enabled, the value label background will be colored based on whether the value is below min (minColor) or above max (maxColor).

enabled.description: Enable bounds highlighting for the value label.

min.description: Minimum threshold value. Values below this (or equal if minInclusive is false) will use minColor background.

max.description: Maximum threshold value. Values above this (or equal if maxInclusive is false) will use maxColor background.

minColor.description: Background color to apply when value is below (or equal to, if minInclusive is false) the minimum threshold.

maxColor.description: Background color to apply when value is above (or equal to, if maxInclusive is false) the maximum threshold.

minInclusive.description: If true, values equal to min are considered in range. If false, values equal to min trigger minColor.

maxInclusive.description: If true, values equal to max are considered in range. If false, values equal to max trigger maxColor.

setpoint.description: When true, the value label is shown in blue and becomes clickable. Clicking opens a modal to enter and submit a new value to write to the tag.

tagNameStyle.description: Custom CSS styles for the tag name label. Use the classes property to apply CSS classes, or add custom CSS properties. These styles will be merged with the default tag name styles.

tagValueStyle.description: Custom CSS styles for the tag value label. Use the classes property to apply CSS classes, or add custom CSS properties. These styles will be merged with the default tag value styles.
